preregistered: 2026-11-07 ~21:45 CT, committed before any HE-15 result was computed
motivation: HE-09/HE-17: payout-size modelling is the gap (#9 Markov over-predicts 20x by 65%; size experts worth ~1.4 points; train-only size regimes cost ~0.6). Test whether regime-switching models learned from history alone recover that structure without validation-derived constants.

stat_temporal_hmm.idea: Per-machine-type hidden Markov model with K states emitting the five payout classes. Parameters (initial, transition, emission) learned by Baum-Welch on FIT-split histories (ticks < cutoff). Missing ticks advance the chain with no emission (never 0x). Prediction: forward-filter the machine's own ticks < cutoff, one transition step, emission mixture.
stat_temporal_hmm.hyperparameters: K in {2,3}; 3 deterministic restarts (seed 0..2), 40 EM iterations; K chosen by FIT-split query-label log score
stat_temporal_hmm.expected: about the counting baselines (~31 official points): no lag structure, so regimes alone should not close much of the gap

stat_temporal_factorized.idea: P(win) from the HE-09 five-class lag-context mixture (1 - p_0), times P(size | win) from a per-type size-regime HMM whose chain runs over ticks and emits only on observed wins (4 size classes). Losses and missing ticks emit nothing.
stat_temporal_factorized.hyperparameters: size HMM K in {2,3} by FIT-split query-label log score; lag mixture as in HE-09
stat_temporal_factorized.expected: better than stat_markov (43.98) and better-calibrated 20x; still below the champion (no stacker, no peer evidence)

stat_temporal_ar1.idea: Bounded temporal baseline: per class k, P(y_c=k) = mu_k + phi_k^(gap) * (x_last - mu_k), where x_last is the class indicator at the last observed tick, mu_k a decayed per-machine mean shrunk to the type mean, phi_k a per-type lag-1 coefficient fit by least squares on FIT-split histories. Clipped to [1e-4, 1] and renormalised onto the simplex.
stat_temporal_ar1.expected: weak; a sanity baseline, not a contender

not_run: SARIMA/SARIMAX: only if training-only seasonality tests justify; scalar expected-payout ARIMA is excluded by the issue.

evaluations.R: #8 registry, 4 condition-stratified whole-episode train folds, sampled-label five-class Brier (not official points)
evaluations.A: fit on TRAIN, official slot_forecasting.rounds.score_round on VALIDATION (development-exposed for the champion only)

decision_rule: No promotion. Interesting only if both R and A improve on the champion with R interval excluding 0. Convergence failures, runtime and negative results are reported.
